rating_line: 5-star rated on Zillow and Google, from 365+ reviews

reviews.quote: “Scott’s successful experience, expansive expertise, communication skills, and practical advice were invaluable throughout every phase of the process. He guided us throughout the process, ultimately allowing us to make final decisions without feeling pressured. He somehow was able to make what could be a stressful and trying experience one that was surprisingly enjoyable!”

“He knows Baton Rouge, always responds quickly, knows his stuff when it comes to different neighborhoods, the market, etc, and is just an awesome person with integrity and honesty. We’ve used him to buy both of our houses, and I really can’t recommend him enough!”

“We have worked with Robin for several years now. She has always been responsive, even if a great amount of time had passed, she was right there answering any question we had. She helped us with a purchase remotely as we were moving from a different state. She also has helped my parents. We will continue to work with Robin for all our real estate needs and highly recommend her services.”

“As I relocated in a hurry to join a new position on the West coast, I left all my belongings in the house. Scott had the house cleaned, he arranged the furniture in a presentable manner, took wonderful photos, and listed it for sale within 2 days. When the home needed minor repairs during the due diligence period, he took care finding the right people and getting the work done immediately. My entire experience with Scott as my realtor has been absolutely wonderful.”

headline: Ready to buy or sell? We're a call away.
intro: Whether you're buying, selling, or just have questions, we'll walk you through every step, from the first conversation to closing day.

why.heading: Why clients choose The Gaspard Team
why.intro: Clients have left The Gaspard Team 269 reviews on Zillow, with a 5.0 average, from 2014 to 2026. The words they use most are knowledgeable, attentive and experienced. These are the things they come back to.

blocks.heading: They know Baton Rouge, neighborhood by neighborhood
blocks.text: Which streets sell fast, what a price point buys in each part of town, and what's changing nearby. That comes from 3,000+ homes sold* across greater Baton Rouge.
blocks.quote: He knows Baton Rouge… knows his stuff when it comes to different neighborhoods.

blocks.heading: Priced right, sold fast
blocks.text: We price your home off what's really selling nearby and get it market-ready, so it sells quickly and for the right number.
blocks.quote: Both homes we have sold with him were under contract in less than 24-hours.

blocks.heading: You'll always hear back
blocks.text: Calls and texts get answered, evenings and Saturdays too. If one of us is out of town, you'll know who's covering.

blocks.heading: Straight advice, and no pressure
blocks.text: An honest read on price, a clear plan, and the final call is always yours. Sometimes that advice is "walk away."
blocks.quote: honest, non sugar-coated advice when we needed it.

blocks.heading: We handle it when you can't be there
blocks.text: Relocating, settling a parent's estate, or selling from out of state, we take care of cleaning, repairs, photos and showings, and keep you posted from wherever you are.
blocks.quote: He had everything covered even after we had left.

blocks.heading: We know the right people
blocks.text: Inspectors, contractors, roofers, lenders: after decades in Baton Rouge we know who does good work and shows up.
blocks.quote: He has an extensive network of Contractors and Vendors.
